title: 第13章  为师替你把把关
slug: 我一杂役怎么成掌门孩子他爹了
content_zh:
“……”
看着坐在一旁修炼的叶长天，月青霜心中也是一阵郁闷。
这都能忍住？
到底是她没有吸引力，还是这家伙根本不行？
要是叶长天真的不行，这咋搞？
算了，不想了！
到底行不行，总得试了才知道。
虽然她来找叶长天主要就是为了双修，可她毕竟是个女人，让她主动开口还是有些难为情的。
既然诱惑不行，那就只能施行师姐教给她的第二个方法了。
一会她就去师尊的后院搞点大补的灵药炖上，然后再弄一坛灵酒，晚上与叶长天不醉不归。
到时酒后一乱，说不定就顺理成章地双修上了。
就这么愉快的决定了！
不过——
月青霜此刻的想法，叶长天自然是不知道的。
他原本只是想要打坐修炼转移下注意力，可一修炼才发现，自己无论是吸纳灵气的速度还是流畅度，都比以前提升了不知道多少倍。
虽然他身上有玄灵宝珠，但这绝对不光是玄灵宝珠能达到的效果。
“难道阴阳造化界诞生的力量，不仅能快速提升实力，还能提升灵根天赋不成？”
叶长天心中惊疑不定。
看来得找个时间测一下自己的灵根天赋了！
倘若他的灵根天赋真的提升了，岂不是意味着他的灵根天赋以后就可以无限提升？

只要有足够的阴阳之力。
哪怕提升到传说中的仙品灵根，都不是没有可能！
仙品灵根！
这在玄黄大世界早已成为传说。
传闻拥有仙品灵根的人，只要中途不夭折，就必定能登临巅峰，问道成仙！
若是阴阳之力真能无限提升灵根，成仙对他好像都不是什么难事！
“叶老弟，在吗？”
就在心中激动万分的时候，一道声音突然从门外传来。
叶长天起身
“方峰主，你这一大清早来找我，究竟所为何事？”
叶长天一脸疑惑地问道。
方云笑着道：“叶老弟，我已经将你突破筑基境的事情上报宗门，宗门决定直接晋升你为内门弟子，你今天就可以去内门报到了。”
“晋升内门弟子？”
叶长天眉毛一挑：“那就多谢方峰主了。”
杂役峰对他来说的确没有呆下去的必要了。
他原本就打算先晋升外门弟子，如今突破筑基境，宗门竟然让他跳过了外门，直接成为了内门弟子。
要知道。
内门弟子乃是宗门重点培养的精英，待遇与外门弟子相比，绝对要好上十倍不止。
不说别的，单是灵石这一项福利就已经天差地别。
外门弟子每月只能领取一百灵石作为修炼资源，而内门弟子至少能领取一千灵石。

尤其是内门弟子中的佼佼者，获得的修炼资源更为丰富！
能够直接晋升内门，叶长天自然是非常乐意的。
更何况——
他那位前未婚正好也在内门。
叶长天也想看看，当他出现在内门的时候，他那位前未婚妻会是什么表情？
简单地收拾了一下行李。
叶长天就拿着方云给他的信物，前往内门报到了。
月青霜因为要施行第二个拿下叶长天的计划，所以决定先回师尊的太玄宫，待准备好一切再去内门找叶长天。
而就叶长天晋升内门弟子的同时。
太玄宫内。
掌门夏秋水的寝宫。
自从前两天在杂役峰与叶长天意外双修后，夏秋水回到太玄宫就在闭关冲击化神境。
本以为自己距离化神境仅有半步之遥，突破已经并非难事。
可不知道为什么。
她这两天却根本难以静下心来，脑海中时不时就回忆起那一夜的事情，莫名出现一些羞人的画面。
最重要的是。
她对那些画面竟然没有丝毫的反感，反而还隐约有那么一丝兴奋的感觉。
“我这到底是怎么了？”
“难道是因为体内的情毒太过霸道，依旧没有完成清除，所以才会产生欲望？”
夏秋水黛眉紧紧地拧在了一起。

她堂堂元婴境，一般情况下已经很难受到影响。
除了这个，夏秋水想不到其他可能。
以她现在的状态，若是强行冲击化神境，稍有不慎恐怕有些走火入魔的风险。
必须得先解决这个问题！
可这要如何解决？
再去找叶长天双修一次？
可她为了让宝贝徒儿月青霜重回巅峰，已经让月青霜去找叶长天双修了。
自己再去找叶长天双修算什么？
她堂堂太玄宗掌门，总不会去跟自己徒弟抢男人吧？
就在夏秋水内心挣扎不已的时候，却是突然感应到了什么，身形一闪就消失在了原地。
下一秒。
夏秋水就出现在了月青霜的面前。
她目光在月青霜身上一扫，微微皱眉道：“青霜，你身体的问题怎么还没解决，难道叶长天没能让你恢复么，这不应该啊。”
“师尊，我……我还没有与叶长天双修。”
月青霜俏脸微微一红，也没有对夏秋水有丝毫的隐瞒，将自己接下来的计划一五一十地说了出来。
青霜还没有与叶长天双修！
夏秋水得知这个消息，心中莫名一阵欣喜。
青霜还没有与叶长天发生关系，这岂不是意味着她现在去与叶长天双修一次，也不算跟青霜抢男人了？
最后一次，就一次！
一切都是为了修行！

只要这次解决了自己身体的问题，她保证绝对不会跟叶长天再有下一次！
“青霜，你身体的问题的确需要尽早解决，时间拖得越久想要恢复恐怕就越困难。”
“那叶长天绝非寻常，你与他结为道侣也并不吃亏。”
夏秋水说到这里，语气微微一顿，看着月青霜淡淡道：“一会你回去找叶长天的时候，让他来太玄宫一趟吧，为师再替你把把关！”
夏秋水也不给月青霜说话的机会，身形一闪就消失在月青霜的面前。
“……”
月青霜看着夏秋水消失的地方，不由呆了一呆。
虽然她也知道，叶长天绝非凡人，甚至很有可能是传说中的仙品灵根。
可究竟能不能让她恢复，那也要试过才知道啊。
这事儿师尊要如何替她把关？
content_en:
"..."
Looking at Ye Changtian who was sitting aside practicing, Yue Qingshuang also felt depressed.
Can you bear this?
Is she unattractive, or is this guy simply not good enough?
If Ye Changzhen really can't do it, what should he do?
Forget it, don’t think about it anymore!
Whether it works or not, you have to try it to know.
Although she came to Ye Changtian mainly for dual cultivation, she was a woman after all, so it was a bit embarrassing for her to take the initiative to speak.
Since temptation doesn't work, she can only use the second method taught to her by her senior sister.
After a while, she went to the master's backyard to stew some tonic elixir, and then made a jar of spiritual wine. She and Ye Changtian would not get drunk at night.
When the drunkenness and confusion comes, maybe it will be a matter of course to start dual cultivation.
Such a happy decision!
But——
Ye Changtian naturally didn't know what Yue Qingshuang was thinking at this moment.
He originally just wanted to meditate and practice to divert his attention, but once he started practicing, he discovered that both the speed and fluency of his ability to absorb spiritual energy had improved countless times compared to before.
Although he has the Xuanling Orb on his body, this is definitely not the only effect that the Xuanling Orb can achieve.
"Could it be that the power born from the Yin-Yang world of creation can not only increase strength quickly, but also increase spiritual talent?"
Ye Changtian was shocked and confused.
It seems like I have to find time to test my spiritual root talent!
If his spiritual root talent really improves, doesn't it mean that his spiritual root talent can be infinitely improved in the future?
As long as there is enough yin and yang power.
Even if it is promoted to the legendary immortal spiritual root, it is not impossible!
Immortal spiritual root!
This has long become a legend in the Xuanhuang world.
It is said that those who have immortal spiritual roots, as long as they do not die in the middle, will surely reach the top and become immortals!
If the power of yin and yang can really enhance the spiritual roots infinitely, becoming an immortal will not seem to be difficult for him!
"Brother Ye, are you there?"
Just when I was extremely excited, a voice suddenly came from outside the door.
Ye Changtian got up
"Master Fang, why did you come to me this early in the morning?"
Ye Changtian asked with a puzzled look.
Fang Yun said with a smile: "Brother Ye, I have reported your breakthrough to the Foundation Establishment Realm to the sect. The sect has decided to directly promote you to the inner sect disciple. You can report to the inner sect today."
"Promoted to inner disciple?"
Ye Changtian raised his eyebrows: "Thank you very much, Master Fang."
There was really no need for him to stay at the Handsome Peak.
He originally planned to be promoted to an outer sect disciple first, but now that he has broken through to the Foundation Establishment realm, the sect actually allows him to skip the outer sect and directly become an inner sect disciple.
To know.
The inner disciples are the elites trained by the sect, and their treatment is definitely ten times better than that of the outer disciples.
Not to mention anything else, the benefit of spiritual stones alone is already a world of difference.
Outer disciples can only receive one hundred spiritual stones as cultivation resources every month, while inner disciples can receive at least one thousand spiritual stones.
Especially the best among the inner disciples will receive even more abundant cultivation resources!
Ye Changtian is naturally very happy to be directly promoted to the inner sect.
What's more -
His ex-fiancé happened to be at the inner gate.
Ye Changtian also wanted to see what his ex-fiancee's expression would be like when he appeared at the inner door.
Simply packed my luggage.
Ye Changtian took the token given to him by Fang Yun and reported to the inner gate.
Because Yue Qingshuang wanted to implement her second plan to capture Ye Changtian, she decided to return to her master's Taixuan Palace first, and then go to the inner gate to find Ye Changtian when everything was ready.
At the same time, Ye Changtian was promoted to an inner disciple.
Inside Taixuan Palace.
The palace of the leader Xia Qiushui.
Since the unexpected double cultivation with Ye Changtian at Zaoyu Peak two days ago, Xia Qiushui returned to Taixuan Palace and was in seclusion to attack the realm of transformation.
I thought that I was only half a step away from the realm of divine transformation, and it was not difficult to break through.
Don't knowWhy.
She couldn't calm down at all in the past two days. From time to time, she recalled the events of that night in her mind, and some embarrassing scenes appeared inexplicably.
The most important thing is.
She didn't have the slightest objection to those pictures, but she still felt vaguely excited.
"What the hell is wrong with me?"
"Is it because the love poison in the body is too overbearing and has not been completely eliminated, so desire arises?"
Xia Qiushui's dark eyebrows knitted together tightly.
She is in the Nascent Soul realm, and it is difficult to be affected under normal circumstances.
Apart from this, Xia Qiushui couldn't think of any other possibility.
In her current state, if she were to force her way into the realm of gods, she might run the risk of going crazy if she wasn't careful.
This problem must be solved first!
But how to solve this?
Go to Ye Changtian for dual cultivation again?
But in order to bring her precious disciple Yue Qingshuang back to her peak, she had asked Yue Qingshuang to go to Ye Changtian for dual cultivation.
What's the point of going to Ye Changtian for dual cultivation on his own?
She, the dignified head of Taixuan Sect, would never compete with her apprentice for a man, would she?
Just when Xia Qiushui was struggling in her heart, she suddenly sensed something and disappeared in a flash.
The next second.
Xia Qiushui appeared in front of Yue Qingshuang.
She glanced at Yue Qingshuang, frowned slightly and said, "Qingshuang, why haven't your physical problems been solved? Could it be that Ye Changtian couldn't help you recover? This shouldn't be the case."
"Master, I...I haven't practiced dual cultivation with Ye Changtian yet."
Yue Qingshuang's pretty face blushed slightly, and she told Xia Qiushui her next plan in detail without hiding anything from her.
Qingshuang has not yet practiced dual cultivation with Ye Changtian!
When Xia Qiushui heard the news, she felt inexplicably happy.
Qingshuang has not yet had a relationship with Ye Changtian. Doesn't this mean that if she goes to have a double practice with Ye Changtian now, it won't be considered as competing for a man with Qingshuang?
The last time, just once!
Everything is for practice!
As long as her physical problems are solved this time, she promises that she will never have another relationship with Ye Changtian!
"Qingshuang, your physical problem really needs to be solved as soon as possible. The longer it takes, the more difficult it will be to recover."
"That Ye Changtian is anything but ordinary. You won't suffer any disadvantage if you become a Taoist couple with him."
When Xia Qiushui said this, he paused slightly, looked at Yue Qingshuang and said calmly: "When you go back to find Ye Changtian later, ask him to come to Taixuan Palace, and he will be the master to check it for you!"
Xia Qiushui did not give Yue Qingshuang a chance to speak, and disappeared in front of Yue Qingshuang in a flash.
"..."
Yue Qingshuang looked at the place where Xia Qiushui disappeared and couldn't help but be stunned for a moment.
Although she also knew that Ye Changtian was an extraordinary person, and he might even have the legendary immortal spirit root.
But whether she can recover or not, we have to try to find out.
How can Master check this matter for her?
